==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} {{LU}}. He can be obtained from clearing Room 100 in [[Infinity Mansion]] and opening the [[Sound Sealed Star]]. Players who achieved a rank of Master or higher by the end of the 1st season were automatically given his shiny version.
